about: S5 城門 (the gate): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; lines from gen/life/vignettes_S4_S6.md and the readings: 名画记 32-35 and 37, 余辉 2014/2015/2021/2023, 東京夢華錄, 事物考, 邵琦, Hansen). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips (sleepers only think). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 貨到稅訖
scenes.reading: 余辉 2023/2015: carters bring textile bales; one declares inside; the inspector points at the bales and names a big sum; the second carter hands over the manifest; the third gapes; the row makes the watchman look down. 余辉 2023 also: transit tax plus sales tax, and 力勝稅錢 on carts; cloth paid the most; a big frame scale for heavy goods. 名画记 35 (hedged): the paper is an 引子 (permit); owner and official argue. Hansen: a plain tax payment. Chosen: 余辉's quarrel, with 名画记's permit. The tower man is 余辉's watchman (Hansen: a sightseer).

scenes.title: 禁軍運酒
scenes.reading: 余辉 2015/2021/2023: the fire post (军巡铺屋; 東京夢華錄 卷三 防火) now holds eight casks; its water butts hold wine, the fire swab (麻搭) lies idle without its hemp; three archers sent to escort the Guards' holiday wine test their gear before the cart comes, the drawer 'probably just had a drink'; the only lively soldiers in the scroll, while the gate itself is unguarded. 名画记 37: three men preparing to set off. Hansen/Columbia: an archery shop. Chosen: 余辉. The third archer (waist guard) stands in S6, so two speak here.

scenes.title: 糧也納稅

The map: a man works at a box pack by the pack donkey, a man holds a pouch at his waist, a man pushes the big sack cart west. Who leads is our proposal (the man with the pouch).

scenes.title: 駝隊出城

Texts that have the caravan entering contradict the painting: it leaves. The map: the driver walks behind the rear camel; a man behind the low roof looks up at the camels; a man in white behind the other roof looks west.

The map: a knot of seven capped men at the gate block's foot, chatting and watching the camel coming out, the veiled rider and the kneeling man. 余辉 2015 看点七 撤防的城门: nobody guards the gate, so these idlers stand where guards should; Hansen gets there too ('so secure it has no soldiers'). The kneeling man: 余辉 2021's 祭拜路神 (chosen over the encyclopedic kneeling beggar). The row inside is the tax line (our proposal).

Chosen: 余辉. The map: one carter pushes at the rear, one hauls at the shafts, a man rides the trace donkey, another stoops at its head.
